instruction.name: ldx.bu
instruction.description: ldx.bu indexed load from rj + rk.

experiments.name: high-unroll load-to-ALU chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.b $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0; st.b $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0' --asm 'ldx.bu $r4, $r20, $r4; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5'

experiments.name: load-to-AGU bypass calibration
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: L1D-hit indexed-load latency: 4 cycles through the load-to-AGU address bypass, 5 cycles through the ALU-consumer path. The measurement experiment adds add.d to force the ALU path; the calibration experiment is the bare index chase.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56' --asm 'ldx.bu $r12, $r20, $r4; ldx.bu $r13, $r20, $r5; ldx.bu $r14, $r20, $r6; ldx.bu $r15, $r20, $r7; ldx.bu $r16, $r20, $r8; ldx.bu $r17, $r20, $r9; ldx.bu $r18, $r20, $r10; ldx.bu $r19, $r20, $r11'
